s01.title: Welcome to AbElements
s01.body: A free, open-source Next.js UI library: eight focused packages that share one theme, with live docs and examples for every element.
s01.illustrationAlt: Diagram: the eight AbElements packages all connect to the AbElements logo.

packages.components: Buttons, tabs, menus & a splash screen

s02.title: Core elements
s02.body: The config, layouts and accessible primitives every other AbElements package builds on.
s02.illustrationAlt: Diagram: the screen, main and aside layouts all connect to the core package.

s03.title: Ready-made components
s03.body: Accessible React UI built on Core and Theme, from buttons and tabs to menus and a splash screen.
s03.illustrationAlt: Diagram: a button, a tab bar, a menu and a splash screen connect to the components package.

s04.title: Warm, tokenised theming
s04.body: Bronze design tokens as CSS variables, with a real dark mode and no flash on load.
s04.illustrationAlt: Diagram: colour swatches and a light and dark switch connect to the theme tokens.

s05.title: Tree-shakable icons
s05.body: SVG icons with typed names. Import only the icons you ship.
s05.illustrationAlt: Diagram: a grid of icons connects to the icon component, with size and weight options.

s06.title: Fonts without layout shift
s06.body: Inter, Zilla Slab, Mulish, Quicksand and Roboto, self-hosted for Next.js with simple font-* utilities.
s06.illustrationAlt: Diagram: five font specimens surround a large “Aa”.

s07.title: Animations that feel right
s07.body: Easings, fades and transitions that respect the reduced-motion setting out of the box.
s07.illustrationAlt: Diagram: an easing curve and a reduce-animations switch connect to the animations package.

s08.title: Typed React hooks
s08.body: Small, typed hooks for the theme, media queries, storage and the clipboard.
s08.illustrationAlt: Diagram: four hooks connect to the hooks package.

s09.title:
Build your web apps

for free with AbElements
s09.body: Eight open-source packages, live docs and one PWA. MIT, free forever.
s09.illustrationAlt: Diagram: the eight packages, the docs and the PWA all connect to AbElements.
